_comment: Atlas Growth UK extensions :: RECOVERY pass 3 over excluded_officp.csv — the UNRATED track, a straight copy of recover-unrated-uk-config.json (2026-09-16, GATE 3 P7). A Maps listing with NO review data fails `review_count >= 5` identically to a 0 (qualify-leads.js:92: num('') -> null -> false, measured 2026-09-16), so every unrated listing died as too_small — 417 rows on the UK foundation run, 107 of them UK, ICP-named, with a live website. This pass takes back exactly the rows that are unrated AND carry a website; the 1-4 band stays dropped because that band IS the ghost filter. Run it over excluded_officp.csv AFTER the two other recoveries (each pass reads the main pass's drop_reason; order among the three does not matter, their scope gates are disjoint). Run: node skills/google-maps-scrape/qualify-leads.js --in <run>/maps/excluded_officp.csv --config clients/atlas-growth/recover-unrated-extensions-uk-config.json --out <run>/maps/recover-unrated

qualify_rules._r: 0. RECOVERY SCOPE GATE — one drop reason only: too_small. A row removed as hard_off_icp_type / off_icp_primary / name_deny / not_in_icp is refused before any other rule is read. Because the floor is the LAST main-pass rule, a too_small row has by construction already passed every deny and the allow.
qualify_rules.label: not_an_unrated_candidate

qualify_rules._r: 1. UNRATED ONLY — the blank band. The 1-4 band stays dropped (has_review_count): those rows were judged on real review data and the floor's verdict stands.
qualify_rules.label: has_review_count

qualify_rules._r: 2. A LIVE WEBSITE is the substitute activity signal. The only place in this rule set that gates on website (the main config refuses to; no-website rows are the STEP 5d recovery track).
qualify_rules.label: no_website
